name: Kirkland Pyra Fest 2024
information: We encourage you to join us in Kirkland for a competition focused on side events! If you wish to also attend a competition with more traditional events like 3x3 and 2x2, you can view all the [many other competitions happening in Washington.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only **ONE guest** per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
